label: common_0320_rival_02
text: We should call and catch each other up on how\nthings are going from now on![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0320_rival_03
text: You decided to set out heading west from the\nschool, right, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0320_rival_04
text: Starting from there, you’ll be pretty close to\nCortondo.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0320_rival_05
text: That’s where you’ll find the Bug-type Gym!\nYou can go take on the Gym Leader if you want![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0320_rival_06
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I’m sure you can beat her,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
Good
luck—I’ll
call
ya soon![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0320_friend_02
text: It’s me—Arven! I was a bit worried ’bout whether\nor not you’d managed to set out yet.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_0320_friend_03
text: You did end up deciding to set out east, right?\nAfter leaving the school?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_0320_friend_04
text: If so, you’re not that far from the area where the\nStony Cliff Titan is said to make its lair.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_0320_friend_05
text: Stories say it clings to cliffs—practically becomes\npart of the stone—then attacks from above![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_0320_friend_06
text:
Though...maybe don’t be staring up overhead all
the time looking for a Titan, only to go tumbling
off some cliff you didn’t see.\c
If that ever does happen, you can open your map
app and call yourself a Flying Taxi to pick you up.\c
Some of those rocky areas are like a real maze,
so try not to get lost, little buddy.\c
And if you find a Titan, let me know![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
